task.action_space: 18 movement commands, always auto-shoot, no requested Bomb/Special

interpretation: A source-controlled action-conditioned collision-risk and wall-aware heuristic greatly outperformed the prior geometric heuristic at staying alive on 16 matched Easy development game seeds without skill activations. This is improvement in handcrafted controller performance, NOT a learned neural policy. No stage clears. Two 10k-frame truncations mean aliveness cannot substitute for completion; future learned-policy evaluation must separately track timeouts, phase progress, deaths and actual threat-conditioned dodging.
next: E3: bounded authentic native behavior-cloning warm start using risk-aware teacher demonstration states/actions; evaluate BC-only and BC→PPO with fixed observation/action spaces against E1 movement-only PPO.
